records.purpose: Push one fixed advisory health enum from the host-selected live plugin. Host timestamps; one accepted record/second; no callback or gameplay effect.
records.buffer_contract:
`sco_result (*submit)(sco_plugin* self, const sco_diagnostics_observation_v1* observation);`
Copies a size-prefixed 8-byte observation; no pointers retained, output, text, identifiers or arbitrary fields.
records.ownership: Host-owned source buffer; selected live plugin only. Advisory health never establishes host/game readiness or faults.
records.thread_affinity: Game thread only; synchronous memory copy, no callbacks or transport.
records.reentrancy: Callable from normal game-thread plugin callbacks; never called by capture or endpoint demand.
records.results: Query NOT_FOUND when default-off/absent; BAD_ARG invalid/released/unselected owner or null/short/unknown record; WRONG_THREAD off game thread; UNAVAILABLE stopped/terminal shutdown; TOO_MANY excess rate or allocation failure.
records.absent_capability: Requires explicit trusted host source opt-in, selected plugin ID and positive offline admission; grants no endpoint admission.
records.cleanup: Host Stop clears ingress before shutdown callouts. Release/quarantine suppresses source; new owner starts empty. Borrowed table is process-lifetime; service reopen clears records.
limitations: Fixed advisory health only; no gameplay or runtime JSON v1 extra fields.
No C#/Lua binding. Windows/MSVC and gameplay unverified.
